title: AddUsageApiKeyWithSignatureRequest
description: ChainSecured usage-key minting. Mirrors `CreateWalletWithSignatureRequest`: the user proves wallet ownership with an EIP-712 typed-data signature, the server mints a usage-key wallet via DStack MPC and returns the secret (as the usage API key) plus address + derivation path. The client follows up with on-chain `registerWalletDerivation` and `setUsageApiKey` signed by their admin wallet — only the admin wallet of a ChainSecured account can call `setUsageApiKey` (see AppStorage.accountExistsAndIsMutable).

typed_data.description: EIP-712 typed-data object the wallet signed. Must use `primaryType: "AddUsageApiKey"` and the canonical schema (see `core::eip712`).

signature.description: 65-byte 0x-prefixed signature (r||s||v) over the EIP-712 digest of `typed_data`.
